correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, 0<r<=1 and real contraction A, SVD gives W(r A B_n)/(2r)=E(sqrt(sum s_j^2 U_j^2)) and Mirsky plus a matching SVD orthogonal factor gives inf_Q ||A-Q||_1=sum_j(1-s_j). For H(t)=1-sqrt(1-t), superadditivity H(sum a_j)>=sum H(a_j) for nonnegative a_j with sum<=1 and the strictly convex scalar chord sqrt(1-x+xs^2)<=(1-s)sqrt(1-x)+s yield the pointwise estimate. The beta(1/2,(n-1)/2) marginal integrates H(U_j^2) to gamma_n=1-Gamma(n/2)^2/(Gamma((n-1)/2)Gamma((n+1)/2)). Strictness excludes any fractional singular value or >=2 deficient singular values; equality occurs exactly at O(n) or rank-(n-1) partial isometries, which prove sharpness. Independent gamma evaluations n=3,4,5 and strict gamma_n<1/n corroborate constants; universality is analytic, not from sampling.
